title: Get started with STID
text: STID provides infection-aware workflow spatial transcriptomics data. Starting processed Seurat object, STID helps users construct standardized STID object, correct pathogen-derived background signal, detect infection-associated spots, identify infection-associated spatial niches, perform downstream single-sample multi-sample niche analysis. vignette gives minimal end--end workflow first-time users. focuses main analysis logic key objects passed steps. full parameter descriptions complete worked examples, see dedicated vignettes listed end. Overview STID workflow. typical analysis contains seven stages: Install STID prepare R environment. Load preprocess spatial transcriptomics data. Convert processed Seurat object STID object. Correct pathogen background signal using control background samples. Detect infection-associated spots using pathogen genes host-response gene sets. Identify infection-associated niches, including foci-type, aggregated-type, dispersed-type niches. Quantify compare niches within one sample across multiple samples. code chunks vignette shown eval = FALSE file paths, sample names, metadata columns, thresholds dataset-specific. Replace example values used study running workflow.

title: Get started with STID
text: Infection-associated spots can detected pathogen genes, host-response genes, gene-set scores. common first pass summarize pathogen gene counts classify spots using count probability threshold. Gene-set-based detection can used capture host responses, viral response, parasite response, programmed cell death, curated biological processes. resulting object stores infection-associated spot labels signal summaries metadata fields can used niche-identification modules.
